title: Carry stack fix: quoted-pipe exemption must not credit Windows .cmd/.bat shims (cmd.exe reinterprets |)
outcome: Carry stack fix: quoted-pipe exemption must not credit Windows .cmd/.bat shims (cmd.exe reinterprets |)
acceptance: A command routed through a Windows batch shim (.cmd/.bat, including package-manager runner shims where they resolve to one) whose arguments contain a quoted pipe is not granted the quoted-pipe exemption, so it earns no credit; the real-executable quoted-pipe case keeps its current behaviour; RED-first regression tests cover both on tree 590ddac3.

The fix is delivered as a patch onto Merger's carry tree 590ddac3; focused tests pass on the patched input, and a fresh read-only Codex+Claude pair on the fix hunks has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
